input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The new Windows accounting export tool likely produces files with UTF-8 BOM (`\uFEFF`) or Windows line endings (`\r\n`). While `parseStatement` strips a leading BOM from the entire text, `text.split("\n")` leaves carriage returns (`\r`) attached to the end of lines, causing field counts or header comparisons to mismatch on row 1 or subsequent rows.

input.title: Handle Windows line endings and carriage returns in statement parser
input.body: Proposed change in src/ingest/parser.ts: handle Windows line endings (\r\n) by stripping trailing carriage returns from lines or normalizing line separators so that header columns and row fields do not contain leftover \r characters causing length mismatches.
